title: Consult an advisor sparsely without transferring ownership
narrative: Fangore's worker hits a consequential planning boundary and asks a stronger advisor for counsel. The worker keeps ownership of the task: advice is guidance, not a hand-off, and a budget must stop low-value routine consultation. See inspiration requirements for the advisor pattern[^insp-advisor].
implementation: `Advisor` / `AdvisorPolicy` in `mechaharness.advisor` are distinct from `GraphEscalation` (ownership transfer). `DefaultAdvisorPolicy` rate-limits consultations; `consult_advisor` records `AdvisorObservation` and never transfers task ownership. Default DI binds `RejectAdvisor` with an explicit continue fallback.
validation: Kind `sparse_advisor_consult` → `_run_sparse_advisor_consult`. Soft expects: first consultation returns guidance; second blocked by budget; observation recorded. Unit: `tests/test_inspiration_primitives.py`.
